visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The scene begins in a dimly lit indoor kitchen where a young woman with long black hair, wearing a white short-sleeved top, is stirring a light-colored soup in a metal pot. She looks sleepy and focuses on the pot. (2) A close-up shows a large cream-colored suitcase being packed with neutral-toned clothing and then zipped shut on a wooden floor. (3) Two women are seen in an elevator mirror; one is filming with a smartphone while the other stands beside her suitcase. (4) In the pre-dawn darkness of a city street, the two women walk alongside parked cars, pulling their suitcases. (5) Inside a metro train, the young woman sits on a seat, leaning her head slightly against the handle of her suitcase, appearing exhausted. (6) The camera follows them through a subway station, showing them navigating stairs and long white-tiled corridors. (7) At an outdoor urban intersection as daylight breaks, the young woman stands with two suitcases, laughing and covering her mouth with her hand. (8) They arrive at a large airport terminal entrance marked with the number 10; they push through glass revolving doors. (9) Inside the bright terminal, the young woman stands near an Aer Lingus check-in counter holding a Starbucks coffee cup. (10) Finally, she waves goodbye and proceeds up a futuristic-looking glass-enclosed escalator towards the boarding area.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A gentle, sentimental piano melody begins. A soft female voice speaks in a calm, narrative tone. A distinct mechanical zipping sound occurs as a suitcase is closed. (2) The acoustic environment shifts to an outdoor street; a low-frequency rumble of early morning traffic is heard, punctuated by the rhythmic, percussive clatter of hard suitcase wheels rolling over asphalt. (3) An electronic chime rings, followed by the metallic hiss and click of automatic train doors opening. Footsteps echo slightly in a cavernous station space. (4) The female voice increases in pitch and arousal, laughing during a conversation. Sound of pages or plastic rustling is heard. (5) The background noise transitions to the steady, wide-bandwidth hum of an airport terminal. The piano music remains consistent, maintaining a warm and nostalgic mood throughout the departure sequence.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video documents a traveler's early morning journey to Charles de Gaulle airport in Paris. It captures the struggles of packing, navigating public transport delays, and getting lost, ultimately concluding with a sentimental farewell as the friend departs for Ireland.
